newsitem.title: ITALY: Tremors hit southern Italy, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Tremors hit southern Italy, no damage reported.

text.p: A series of earth tremors shook areas of southern Italy and the Aeolian Islands off Sicily early on Thursday causing panic but no apparent damage, seismologists and the fire brigade said.
Hundreds of worried Neapolitans called the fire brigade and several people took to the streets in the inland town of Benevento.
The tremors, which began shortly after midnight, measured 4.0 on the open-ended Richter scale, Italy's earthquake monitoring centre said.
Naples and its hinterland were struck by a powerful earthquake in 1980 which killed thousands of people.
